settings.name: layout.menuBar
settings.description: The bar of menus at the top.

settings.name: layout.keyBar
settings.description: The bar at the bottom that lists the keys that work where the cursor is.

settings.name: layout.stations
settings.description: Where the icons that open the views are drawn: down the left, along the top, or not at all.

settings.name: layout.zoom
settings.description: The size of everything, in percent.

settings.name: fonts.*
settings.description: A font family list or a size, as CSS writes it.

settings.name: ui.*
settings.description: A colour of the window: bars, panes, menus.

settings.name: roles.*
settings.description: The colour of what a span of text is: a path, a heading, a mark.

settings.name: chips.*
settings.description: The colour of the chip a claim shows in the gutter.

settings.name: modes.*
settings.description: The colour of the mode badge on the status line.

settings.name: syntax.*
settings.description: The colour of a kind of token in code.
